data.title: One file, *one template*
data.subtitle: Minutes 8 to 15 of 20. About me now, the rest tomorrow.

items: Liked a past document? Put it in **Templates**

blocks.text: **My readers** and **My style** can wait until tomorrow. Each takes about ten minutes.
No template yet? Your first good output becomes one.
Interview me for About me.md. One question at a time, eight at most. Then write it under Role, Main work, Current priorities, People, Terms. One screen.
Claude copies template **details** closely. Swap names, numbers and dates for [placeholders].
